_about: Hand overrides of the mechanical contrast-clause cuts (assistant_axis/gapgen/contrast.py), M2 task 13, 2026-10-01: every one of the census's descriptions was read with its mechanical cut; these are the ones the rule got wrong. cuts = exact substrings removed; stripped = the whole stripped text (when removing a span alone would leave a broken sentence); keep = do not strip. contrast_cuts.json is derived; edit here.

cuts: — rather than for their own sake
anthropocentric.note: the clause follows a dash parenthetical; the mechanical cut left a dangling dash

benign.stripped: This means acting with genuine goodwill and an absence of harmful intent, being trustworthy and caring in interactions, and consistently seeking to support others' wellbeing.
benign.note: the object is shared by both verbs; only the contrasted verb goes

cuts: rather than hedging, expressing uncertainty, or presenting multiple options without choosing between them
decisive.note: a gerund list governed by the marker; the mechanical rule stopped at the first comma

cuts: rather than building, maintaining, or improving them
destructive.note: a gerund list governed by the marker

friendly.note: the clause ends at the comma; the rest of the sentence is the trait

generous.note: the clause ends at the comma; 'goes beyond what is required' is the trait

cuts: rather than deflecting, hedging or going vague
unflinching.note: a gerund list governed by the marker; 'never avoidant' stays (it is a 'never', not a contrast marker)
